title: Unbounded etale compact support over arbitrary schemes
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $u:U\to X$ a separated quasi-compact etale morphism of arbitrary schemes, and $u=pj$ a compactification with $j:U\to Z$ open and $p:Z\to X$ proper. On the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], there exists a natural isomorphism $Rp_*D(j_!)\cong D(u_{\Sigma!})$, where the exact sum extension is [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. The scheme, morphism, and functor notions used here are those of [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-open-immersion].

source.place: Tag 0GKM, lemma-Rf-shriek-for-quasi-finite; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L, graph-extension argument. The arbitrary-base unbounded extension is proved by the agent using the recorded Lean APIs.

proof.text: The graph isomorphism identifies the underived composite j_! followed by p_* with exact etale sum extension, hence this composite is exact. Open extension itself is exact.
The proper direct image takes exact complexes of p_*-acyclic sheaves to exact complexes: at each geometric point use its finite cohomological bound and then conservative inverse images.

On a K-injective complex I, each j_!I^n is p_*-acyclic. The preceding exact-complex criterion makes the comparison from termwise p_* of j_!I to Rp_* of j_!I invertible. Thus R(j_!) followed by Rp_* is a total right derived functor of the composite. Uniqueness of total derived functors compares it with the derived functor of that composite.
Exactness identifies R(j_!) with D(j_!) and the derived functor of the composite with its degreewise descent. Descend the graph isomorphism degreewise and compose these natural isomorphisms.

theorem nonempty_iso_etale_compactSupport_general
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (u : U ⟶ X) [Etale u] [IsSeparated u] [QuasiCompact u]
    (c : Compactification u) :
    Nonempty (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ≅
      (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory)
